title: Vans for a food bank's weekend drive
heading: A Linear Constraint Has Whole-Number Coefficients
cases: a fleet that carries the demand is allowed, and one a few pallets short is refused
a fleet within the budget is allowed, and a dearer one is refused
a fleet with one van per driver is allowed, and one with more vans than drivers is refused
a count that is not a whole number of packs is refused even when every row holds
a count above what the dealer has is refused even when it is a whole number of packs
